title: Chapter 384: Mutation
content:
Chapter 384: Mutation

"Miss, please go back."

In the ancestral land of the human race, Sora was wearing a simple black suit and spoke in a respectful tone to the woman in a blue skirt with her back facing her.

There seemed to be no expression on his face, and he would always be so indifferent.

However, his eyes were extremely captivating, and just a glance seemed to be able to fall into it and fall into the abyss forever.

And a little further away, An Changzai looked at the scene in front of him, shook his head and sighed.

"Tsk, it's boring."

Huo Xingzhi curled his lips and turned around and left.

Wu Shang sighed heavily and sighed with his eyes.

What is out of reach in one's own eyes is at your fingertips.

What's even more annoying is that they don't want it yet.

Comparing people with others is so annoying.

An Changzai's face was much calmer. After watching for a long time, she suddenly said, "I don't know if the conditions for joining this deserted city are harsh."

Wushang:?

Huo Xingzhi:? ?

An Changzai:? ? ?

"Sorry, Huangcheng's family is a big business, I am a poor little girl who no one loves, and I can't afford to stay."

Lu Xue's tone was a little calm, and she looked like she didn't care at all.

Hearing Lu Xue's words, Kong was fluctuating and stood behind Lu Xue like this. For a moment, the scene became a little silent.

At this time, there was a movement from Lu Xue's cuff.

Ao Qing's head came out at some point. He looked at Lu Xue, then turned his head to look at Kong.

"Come, where is my master?"

Kong shook his head, "I don't know."

Ao Qing frowned.

What is this master doing? He really doesn't take his daughter seriously.

Ao Qing was silent for a moment, slowly emerged from Lu Xue's sleeves and flew behind Lu Xue.

He winked at Sora.

——Just make it hard and tie the little master back.

Kong's face remained unmoved, but he still looked back at Ao Qing.

——With the lady’s personality, I’m afraid I will hold a grudge against me.

Although Kong doesn't care about many things, Lu Xue is also the daughter of the city lord.

Ao Qing looked firm and blinked.

——What happens is mine!

Seeing this, Kong slowly breathed, as if he had made a decision.

And at this moment, a familiar voice suddenly sounded.

"Xiaoxue, are you angry with your father?"

Hearing this sound, Lu Xue couldn't help but tremble slightly, but she still didn't turn her head.

But Kong and Ao Qing hurriedly saluted respectfully at the source of the sound.

"Master Lord, you are back."

"Master, you're back."

Lu Daosheng's face was complicated, and there was still a smile on his face, but this smile seemed a little reluctant at this moment.

He nodded slightly to Kong and Ao Qing, and then looked at the woman in blue dress in front of him again.

His biological daughter.

"Xiaoxue, everyone must have their own growth experience."

Lu Daosheng looked at Lu Xue and was still preaching.

In response to this, Ao Qing's mouth twitched slightly.

Master, can't you really see what the little master wants now?

Sure enough, Lu Xue's originally cold face suddenly became a little colder. She clenched her fists slightly, bit her red lips, and her eyes were already red and wet.

Over the years, she has worked hard to change herself and strive to become a unique person.

She did this not for herself, but just hoped that her father would be proud of her.

Later, my dad was indeed proud of her.

But she found that it did not make her happy either.

She still hopes to go back to her childhood, although her life is not as rich as it is now, she is very happy.

Every time I ran back from outside, my dad would always wait for her at home with a smile.

"Dad, look, this is the wild fruit I picked from the back mountain!"

The picture changed and it was in a somewhat simple little room.

The dirt-faced little girl held a bag of green wild fruits and handed them to Lu Daosheng with a flauntful look on her face.

"Oh? Xiaoxue is great. She can actually pick so many."

Lu Daosheng laughed and reached out to touch the little girl's little head, his eyes full of love.

He took out a wet towel and gently wiped the little girl's dirty face.

At this time, the little girl had already put down her pocket and quickly picked the largest wild fruit from it, reaching it directly to Lu Daosheng's mouth.

"Dad, try it!"

The little girl's eyes were shining and she looked expectant.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng did not hesitate at all and took a big bite.

Even though he knew that the fruit was not yet ripe, even though he knew that the fruit would be extremely sour, and even though his taste buds were already complaining wildly, he still showed a very happy smile.

"Wow, it's so delicious. Xiaoxue is so good!"

Lu Daosheng gave a thumbs up at the little girl and kept nodding in praise.

But the little girl's face was a little abnormal.

"Dad, why is there half a bug on this fruit?"

"Where did the other half go?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was slightly stunned and looked down. He saw that half a fat little bug was squirming wildly on the piece of fruit he had just bitten off.

Lu Daosheng's stomach rolled, but he still held a smile on his face.

"Xiaoxue, this is called fruit worm, it can be eaten and has a very high nutritional value. I didn't expect that you can still get this. I'm so lucky."

"Really? Daddy, you didn't lie to me, did you?"

A smile appeared on the little girl's face again.

Lu Daosheng chuckled: "How could Dad lie to you?"

"Dad, I want to eat too!"

"Hey hey, these fruits have not been washed yet. I will eat them after they are washed."

"Oh, okay."

......

The scenes of the past are constantly retracing from Lu Xue's mind.

Once upon a time, all this became like this.

Lu Xue, haven’t you always liked to go out for a walk?

Lu Xue, don’t you like to stay in the deserted city?

Why, why?

"No, that's not what I want."

Lu Xue shook her head gently, and a drop of clear liquid slid from the corner of Lu Xue's eyes.

Finally, Lu Xue turned around and looked at Lu Daosheng.

An unnatural smile appeared on Lu Xue's face.

"Dad, I will make you proud of me, I will definitely."

Suddenly, Lu Xue's breath suddenly began to change.

That aura was very arrogant and domineering, and had no similarity to Lu Xue's aura.

This sudden scene shocked everyone present.

Lu Daosheng didn't expect this scene.

His face darkened, and a divine light suddenly appeared in his pupils, and his captivating eyes looked at Lu Xue.

In just a moment, Lu Daosheng noticed the source of Lu Xue's changes.

"So brave, even my daughter Lu Daosheng dares to get involved?!"

Lu Daosheng roared and grabbed Lu Xue suddenly.

The terrifying aura made everyone present frightened and trembled all over.

Lu Xue, wrapped in the breath, looked even pale and blood flowed out of the corners of her mouth.

Seeing Lu Xue being injured, Lu Daosheng was shocked and quickly calmed down his breath.

But at this moment, Lu Xue suddenly rose up and suddenly distanced herself from Lu Daosheng.
